steps.note: S1.1 asserts the lemma (exchange up to sign, scratch restored) with the line-729 statement quote, but never states the net change (JV+RG)x or why it is independent of the scratch values.
No step gives the bit-case central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2 or the side wires cancelling the intersection-one cases; S1.3.1 gives only the inner product <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1 for labels.
The complex-case coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2 and the side cancellation of intersections zero and two appear nowhere in the plan.
S1.1 says forward, backward, forward exchanges the banks up to sign, but does not give the stage sequence (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x).
The plan does not give the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions; S1.3 says only that adjacent labels are nested.
The side edge 2->5 argument (t_X⊥t_Y gives <t_X>⊂t_Y^⊥, complement <t_X,t_Y>^⊥ of dimension h-2) is absent; S1.3.1 states only that neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal.

The plan states that the only decreasing edges are center 3->4, losing h; that the signed sum telescopes with sources N and sinks Wm-N to give Wm-2N; and that absolute values add 2L to give Wm-2N+2L, quoting lines 999, 1066 and 1070 in their roles.

The F2 argument that nonzero residuals are nondegenerate and nonalternating, with alternating planes absorbed into an orthonormal basis, is absent; S2.1 only presupposes an orthonormal basis of each residual.
S1.3.3 gives L_b/N=100/539 but the complex ratio L_c/N=101/539 is never stated, so only half of the defining content is there.
The plan does not state that weight is additive mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors, nor the phase-difference formula q_V-q_U=sum wt(v)[v·x].
S2.1 names the translation kernels aI+bX_v but not their derivation from odd wt(v), the phase i^{ε[v·x]}, or H diag(1,-1) H = X.

S2.1 says there is one kernel per basis vector and s<Wm in all, but never addresses k columns or each residual vector giving one tensored factor across them; S1.3's single-column claim does not cover the tensoring.

S2.1 asserts the result that the endpoint operator is C^{⊗m} after corrections, but none of the content: frames I and C^{⊗m}, C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates, the Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} repair via C=iZC^{-1}Z, or the negated X outputs.
The plan states L_b/N<1/2, hence the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s=Wm-N+2L<Wm (shown for the bit network, which matches the paper's derivation).
The exact value η_b=339/22587335000000 does not appear.
The exact value η_c=73/19906842167500 does not appear.

S1.3.5 states that the relative deficit exceeds 20·2^{-50} and log m<20, so τ=1-2^{-50} gives s/W<m^τ, quoting line 1341. It leaves the step m exp(-2^{-50}log m)>m(1-η) implicit, and σ=τ is stated only in S5.1.
S1.4.1 states the factorization A=E_1ΠE_2 with a ones but not the elimination proof (pivot at the topmost row's rightmost entry, lower-triangular clearing, repetition on the active indices).
The plan never mentions choosing a fixed odd prime that avoids the table's denominators so that the rational factors specialize invertibly to Z/q^b.

S1.4 says triangular changes run in linear time 'in tape order' with a later field updated from earlier ones. It does not say to update in descending physical order, which is what keeps the earlier coordinates at their original values, so the mechanism is not stated.
S1.4.3 says each one of Π is done by two controlled updates around one interchange, a in all, but omits the updates themselves (D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j), naming the step without its content.
S2.7 uses ⌈C_0 d^{C_1}⌉ but never defines E, B, ν, C_1 or C_0, nor gives ν=11 and C_1=20.
The arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, with the leaf bound 8e and the per-invocation count below E, is absent; S2.6.2 is the time recurrence, not the depth one.
The unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^ν to A(e)<=8B^2 d^{ν+1}, and the total below C_0 d^{C_1}, appear nowhere.
S2.7 states p+⌈C_0d^{C_1}⌉ fractional bits and εC_1<1 giving O(p) width. It omits the mechanism that depth ℓ places values in 2^{-(p+ℓ)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^ℓ, and the Δ+3 integer bits.
S2.8 states that every row of the layer operator has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and the single truncation errs by less than √2·2^{-p}, quoting line 2751.

summary: P11 has 4 of the 26 sub-steps present: L3, R1, R4 and S5. It follows the paper's dimension telescoping, the rank deficit and the explicit exponent bound, but it states the bank exchange, the residual table, the phase interface, the shear lemma and the guard-width bound only as results, without the sub-derivations, and it omits the explicit deficits η_b, η_c and the complex ratio L_c/N.
